patronOf.en-US: Bread and wine are brought to the altar
patronOf.pt-BR: O pão e o vinho são levados ao altar

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Blessed are you, Lord God of all creation, for through your goodness we have received the bread we offer you: fruit of the earth and work of human hands, it will become for us the bread of life.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Bendito sejais, Senhor, Deus do universo, pelo pão que recebemos de vossa bondade, fruto da terra e do trabalho humano, que agora vos apresentamos, e para nós se vai tornar pão da vida.

meta.basis: The corporal, purificator, chalice and Missal are placed on the altar and the faithful bring up the bread and wine (GIRM 73, 139–140); the priest 'holds it slightly raised above the altar with both hands and says quietly' the blessing of the excerpt, then the minister presents the cruets (GIRM 141–142; the Order of Mass rubric). The people sit (GIRM 43). 'Slightly raised', not the elevation: the paten stays just above the altar.
